title_zh: GEPA：反思式提示演化可超越强化学习
one_line: GEPA reflects on execution feedback to mutate module prompts, retaining complementary Pareto candidates and selecting the best validation performer.

title_zh: RRSI：智能体运行框架的正则化递归自我改进
one_line: RRSI edits harness components from execution feedback, retaining candidates through leakage screening, noise-aware acceptance, cost constraints, and pruning.
one_line_zh: RRSI依据执行反馈修改框架，以防泄漏、噪声门槛和剪枝决定留存。

held_out.quote: In each domain the harness is evolved on a single suite, and is then run unchanged on held-out benchmarks.

cross_task.quote: SWE-bench Verified gains 1.8 points although repository-level bug fixing was never scored.

budget_matched.quote: All the baselines start from the same and share the frozen policy, the evolve set and the candidate budget.

retained_ablation.quote: Figure 3 reports every number against the unevolved base harness measured in the same window, so no gain can be attributed to drift in the evaluation infrastructure.

leakage_guard.quote: Before full evaluation, a critic reads each candidate diff and rejects edits that explicitly encode task names, entity names, task-specific values, answers, or other logic specific to the evolve benchmark, as well as edits that add inert machinery.

evidence_level.quote: SWE-bench Verified gains 1.8 points although repository-level bug fixing was never scored.

S1.quote: RRSI therefore records, for every evaluated candidate, the component it modifies, the hypothesis it tests, the source diff, the resulting score and cost changes, and whether the candidate was accepted.

S2.quote: mechanisms with insufficient evidence of utility are removed entirely, so the retained harness becomes structurally sparser rather than merely cheaper in aggregate.

S3.quote: Without the acceptance constraints the evolve-set score rises from 90.5 to 91.5 while the out-of-distribution average falls from 43.6 to 41.0 and token cost rises by half

S4.quote: We ablate the two groups of regularizers, (i) the proposal-side constraints and (ii) the acceptance-side constraints.

S6.quote: The correspondence is again qualitative, i.e., Lasso reduces the number of parameters through regularization, whereas our pruning rule deletes discrete harness components based on their observed contribution.

F1.quote: A candidate must satisfy several non-compensatory criteria before its score can justify replacing the incumbent.

F2.quote: Our study focuses on harness-level recursive self-improvement with frozen backbone models, and therefore does not address settings where model weights are updated during evolution.

F3.quote: Before evolution, we repeatedly evaluate the unchanged base harness and estimate an empirical noise band .

F5.quote: Components that remain unproductive are reported to the proposer as deletion targets in subsequent rounds.

ap1.quote: RRSI deliberately leaves open: prompts, control flow, configuration, context management, tools, skills, memory, and subagents may all be modified, added, or removed.
